findings_addressed.oracle: Pixel-by-pixel comparison between an empty EntropyGraphWidget render and the same widget loaded with real PE entropy data: the two QImages must differ at at least one sampled pixel (stride 4), proving the paintEvent draws polyline segments in response to data rather than being a no-op.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/ui/panels/hex_editor/widgets.py EntropyGraphWidget.paintEvent, replace the loop that draws line segments (lines 179-189) with a single `return` statement after the `if not values: ... return` early-exit — the empty-vs-data pixel comparison would then find zero differing pixels and the assertion `differing > 0` would fail.

findings_addressed.oracle: After constructing LargeFileSettingsDialog(2048, 256, 42.5), use QWidget.findChild(QCheckBox) to obtain the prefetch checkbox via public Qt API, call setChecked(False) on it, then assert dialog.prefetch_on_scroll is False. This is an independent oracle: the property must read from the checkbox state rather than returning a hardcoded constant.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/ui/panels/hex_editor/widgets.py LargeFileSettingsDialog.prefetch_on_scroll, change `return self._prefetch_check.isChecked()` to `return True` — the assertion `dialog.prefetch_on_scroll is False` after toggling the checkbox would then fail.

notes: G0037: Replaced the no-assertion _force_paint smoke call with a comparative render: an empty EntropyGraphWidget and the data-loaded widget are both rendered to QPixmaps; the resulting QImages are sampled at stride-4 grid points and the count of differing pixels is asserted > 0. This is falsifiable because replacing the line-drawing loop in paintEvent with a no-op leaves both renders identical. G0036: Replaced the tautological `prefetch_on_scroll is True` assertion (which verified a hardcoded default) with a toggle gate: the QCheckBox child widget is retrieved via dialog.findChild(QCheckBox) (public Qt API, no private attribute access), toggled to False, and then dialog.prefetch_on_scroll is asserted to be False. This is falsifiable because changing the property to return a constant True would fail the post-toggle assertion.
